== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Andy Talaga]]
* '''Event:''' [[2025 Retro Online Championship Series]] (3rd, semifinals)<ref name="t86215">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86215 2025 Retro Online Championship Series], forum.starwarsccg.org; final ranking by Leverandon (24 December 2025) and post by hdwgitm (16 January 2026) attaching "ROCS25 - Final 8 Decks.zip". * '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 ROps andytalaga DS 2025 ROCS.txt|Download]]
